create_ate_solver: create an Adaptive Tsallis Entropy solver with configurable p, learning rates, and variance reduction
compute_gradients_ate: compute exploitability gradients and regularized exploitability estimates for the ATE solver
run_mirror_descent_step: run entropic mirror descent update step on solver parameters with log-space projection
run_euclidean_descent_step: run projected gradient descent update step with euclidean simplex projection
calculate_exploitability: calculate tsallis entropy regularized exploitability for a given policy distribution
